reason: The design controls for pre-period confounders (size, age, baseline patents) and correctly leaves out the post-treatment collaboration index, which is a mediator. I re-ran it with all other 2020 covariates, region, listing and segment, and without the 1% outcome trim. The estimate stays positive and significant (about 0.75, p about 0.001), so the 'positive effect' conclusion holds, though it is observational.
